notes: I replaced the quadratic (which overshot badly near the edges, e.g. -6.7 vs -4.9 at x=-0.75) with a piecewise-linear interpolation through the observed fine-shape points, keeping zero outside (-1,1). The bump is asymmetric and steeper on the left, so a single quadratic can't capture it; the interpolation matches all known interior values exactly and stays zero at the boundaries.
